description: This file is a React component named DraftPersonaClient that manages the UI for editing, saving, regenerating, and finalizing a draft persona within a Next.js application. It handles fetching drafts from backend or local storage, updating drafts via user input, and orchestrating publish actions.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string into an object, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into an array of trimmed strings, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms an unknown input into an array of CareerHighlightItem objects, handling different input formats.

methods.name: looksLikePersonaDraftSchema
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an object conforms to the PersonaDraftSchema shape.

methods.name: looksLikeLegacyDraft
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an object conforms to the LegacyDraftPersona shape.

methods.name: toEditableModel
methods.description: Converts various draft json formats into a unified EditableDraftModel.

methods.name: applyEditsToDraft
methods.description: Applies user edits from EditableDraftModel to an original draft object, preserving schema structure.

methods.name: fetchLatestPersistedDraft
methods.description: Fetches the latest draft JSON from backend API for the given personaId.
